notes: Account: mid-market SaaS — customer-facing search + recommendations product for B2B marketplaces.
Primary contact: Lina Chen (Head of Product). Very pragmatic — wants measurable improvements to click-through and MRR retention from relevance changes.
Use-case summary: currently use Elastic + in-house rerank signals. Exploring Redwood hosted API for quick iteration on reranking model stacks, then Dedicated if performance/cost justify.

POC ask: reranking endpoint with offline scoring mode for nightly batch scoring (200M rows/month) + online low-latency rerank for search sessions (p50 target <100ms, p95 <250ms) — need autoscaling guardrails.
Relevance tuning: they expect to run 10-20 eval sets (product-specific intents) and want metrics export (MRR lift, NDCG) integrated into Redwood Optimize or via S3 dumps.
Model preferences: prefer open weights (Llama 2 / Mistral variants) with quantized variants for Dedicated; willing to test a Redwood-verified model profile first on Hosted.
Routing/fallback: require policy to route to cheaper quantized variant during non-peak and fallback to smaller model on quota breaches. Also want canary rollouts for rerankers per traffic slice.
Security/compliance: SOC2 in process, must have SSO (SAML) + audit logs and ability to purge customer PII on request. Data residency: US region required for production data.

Cost sensitivity: mid-high. Running numbers show they need < $0.015 per 1k tokens equivalent for offline scoring to justify Dedicated commit; online cost budget tighter — prefer per-request blended pricing for Hosted during POC.
